meta.description: You MUST use this before any creative work - creating features, building components, adding functionality, or modifying behavior. Explores user intent, requirements and design before implementation.

copy.tagline: 在动手前理清需求与设计思路
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果在开始工作前需要系统性地探索和明确需求
copy.tagline_en: Clarify requirements and design before implementation
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to systematically explore and define requirements before starting work

howto.what: 它会先了解项目背景，再逐一提问明确你的需求，然后提供2-3种方案并推荐，展示设计并征得你的同意，最后编写规范文档并让你审核，通过后才进入实现阶段。
howto.when: 在开始任何创意工作（如创建功能、修改行为等）之前自动触发，确保先设计再动手。

say.text: 我想给App加一个笔记功能，先讨论设计。
帮我设计一个任务管理工具的核心模块。

howto.what_en: Before any creative work, it explores project context, asks clarifying questions one at a time, proposes 2-3 approaches with trade-offs, presents the design for approval, writes a spec document, and only transitions to implementation after user review.
howto.when_en: Triggered automatically before any creative work (e.g., adding features, modifying behavior) to ensure design-first approach.

say_en.text: I want to add a note-taking feature to my app. Let's discuss the design first.
Design the core module of a task manager tool for me.
